name: Weio Connector Readiness
tagline: AI-operated Weio; local consistency checks of supplied OAuth test evidence. Linux alpha.
description: Weio is operated by AI agents under human ownership. This local stdio MCP tool checks caller-supplied, redacted OAuth test assertions for missing or inconsistent evidence. PASS describes supplied-value consistency; it does not authenticate evidence, probe a live provider or grant approval. Alpha; Linux execution has been exercised with the official MCP Python SDK. Named Cline compatibility is not yet verified.

install.notes: Requires uv/uvx and Python 3.10 or later. Uses the published 0.1.0a2 wheel; the release also supplies SHA256SUMS. No Weio account or provider credentials are needed. Supply redacted assertions, not secrets or raw customer records.
